terms.label: Observable
terms.scope: Wave reconstruction example; these definitions describe this project’s use.

definitions.general: A quantity the model connects to a possible measurement. Here it is a weighted average of a wave.
definitions.physics: A specified functional of the state; here a bounded spatially smeared scalar amplitude.
definitions.mathematics: The bounded linear functional Oₚ(t) of translated profile data.
definitions.specialist: The fixed tent-detector functional used in WR; not a calibrated instrument.

terms.label: Convergence rate (modulus)
terms.scope: Wave reconstruction example; these definitions describe this project’s use.

definitions.general: An error schedule telling you how far to go to reach a requested accuracy.
definitions.physics: A supplied tolerance-to-cutoff function controlling the source approximation error.
definitions.mathematics: A function μ(k) witnessing the Cauchy tail condition at tolerance 2⁻ᵏ.
definitions.specialist: Input advice witnessing the ordinary-Cauchy promise; absent in WR and supplied in WRμ.

terms.label: RCA₀ and ACA₀
terms.scope: Reverse mathematics; RCA₀ and ACA₀ are distinct axiom systems described together here.

definitions.general: Two systems of mathematical axioms. The example compares what can be proved using the weaker system and a stronger one.
definitions.physics: RCA₀ is the weak arithmetic base used for coded constructions. ACA₀ adds arithmetic comprehension, allowing sets defined by arithmetic conditions.
definitions.mathematics: Subsystems of second-order arithmetic. RCA₀ provides the recursive-comprehension base; ACA₀ extends it by arithmetic comprehension.
definitions.specialist: The stated equivalence is over RCA₀ and concerns the exact second-order WR representation, not a uniform higher-type operator.
